description: Canonical first-week spine copy (CLR-1/2/3 single source). Surfaces must import from this file; hard-coding any block elsewhere fails guard:first-week-spine. Word budgets enforced by scripts/check-first-week-spine.mjs. Variant A (trial = Active tier) per D-A ruling 2026-07-30.
heading: Here's your first week with Starting Monday

steps.label: Today, in 10 minutes
steps.body: Create your free account and tell us your target roles and companies. No credit card. Employers never see you.

steps.label: Tomorrow morning
steps.body: Your first briefing arrives: roles likely to open, the signals behind them, and one priority action.

steps.label: Within your first week
steps.body: Every company you named is under watch. Your briefing shows what we scanned, what we ruled out, and what passed.

steps.label: Every Monday
steps.body: A weekly review keeps your search moving. Cancel anytime and keep everything you've built.

steps.label: When your search intensifies
steps.body: Upgrade for daily execution and deeper prep, or invite a coach to work alongside you.

trustLine: Cancel anytime. Keep your data. Never visible to employers.
guaranteeLine: Free for 30 days. No credit card. Delete everything anytime.
confirmationLine: After you confirm, setup takes about 10 minutes and your first briefing arrives tomorrow morning.
